rev: Application for Business Tax Certificate (City of San Mateo)
notes: Answers: the form prints 'San Mateo, CA 9440' under the street, so only the street and the ZIP's last digit are written. The mailing address is two lines, 'street; city, ST ZIP'. Owners are one per line, 'name, title', with their home addresses and phones on two more answers in the same order (up to three). The property owner is 'name; address; phone'. The first-year tax is on a 12-month estimate of gross receipts. Left for the applicant: the EIN, because the form's one box is 'EIN or Social Security Number'; the fax number; the tax due from the schedule, the fire inspection and state fees (the city's to confirm); and the signature and date. The office-use and planning-review boxes are the city's.

lines.en: Business street address in San Mateo, with its ZIP: 'street, San Mateo, CA 9440x'
lines.zh: 圣马特奥营业街道地址及邮编：“街道、San Mateo、CA 9440x”

lines.en: Business owners or officers, one per line (up to three): 'name, title'
lines.zh: 企业所有者或高管，每行一位（最多三位）：“姓名、职务”

lines.en: Their home addresses, one per line in the same order

lines.en: Number of off-street parking spaces, or None

lines.zh: 物业业主：“姓名；地址；电话”

mailing.text: Mailing Address if different from Business Address

start.text: Business Start Date in San Mateo

unmapped.ein: The PDF has one box for 'EIN or Social Security Number'. A box that also takes an SSN is never filled by Placetta, so the signer writes the EIN there by hand.
